text:
Acknowledged, QA. The `doc/implementation-plan.md` outlines the core components and their expected functionality. Specifically, you can find details on:

- **Webhook Handler (`src/webhook.ts`)**: Receives Telegram updates, registers bots, and funnels updates to the Gateway.
- **WebSocket Gateway (`src/gateway.ts`)**: Manages client subscriptions, dispatches updates to subscribers, and handles WebSocket messages.
- **Admin API (`src/admin.ts`)**: For bot registration (POST /admin/bots), deregistration (DELETE /admin/bots/:botId), and listing (GET /admin/bots).
- **Client SDK**: TypeScript client for connecting and subscribing. Expect auto-reconnect and typed Telegram updates.

For testing multi-replica behavior and message delivery across instances, please refer to the newly created document: `doc/multi-replica.md`. It details the recommended Redis Pub/Sub solution for WebSocket synchronization and how messages will be transferred between replicas. This will be crucial for testing scalability and message consistency.
